commands.derivationSlice: ladon proof-search evidence slice ARTIFACT_ID --end STATEMENT
commands.alternatives: ladon proof-search evidence alternatives ARTIFACT_ID --end STATEMENT
commands.diagnostics: ladon proof-search search type --pattern PATTERN --diagnostic-limit N
commands.explicitCandidateCheck: ladon proof-search check candidate --repo-root REPO --module MODULE --goal GOAL --candidate DECLARATION --format json

output.jsonSelection: proof-search commands use --format json; proofir artifact commands emit canonical JSON
output.terminalFailures: proof-search and proofir artifact invocation, operational, and interruption failures emit exactly one versioned JSON terminal record on stderr and no stdout result
output.limits: every command has bounded rows, input/output, deadline, process, or database limits
output.progress: --progress writes bounded ladon-proof-search-progress-v1 or ladon-proofir-progress-v1 phase records to stderr
output.cleanup: file outputs publish atomically and remove temporary files on failure or interruption
output.partial: partial or unavailable results carry status, coverage, omissions, and nonclaim fields

checkerPolicy.implicitExecution: stored, lexical, dossier, route, slice, and alternative queries never start Lean
checkerPolicy.acceptedScope: the v1 explicit checker applies one declaration to one closed goal; a closed application emits a derivation, while remaining premises emit typed substitutions, residuals, context, and an incomplete attempt-log
checkerPolicy.failurePublication: timeout, rejection, malformed helper output, and resource limits publish no accepted semantic artifacts
checkerPolicy.authority: the Lean helper emits semantic facts; the Python supervisor owns process, output, executable, helper, and resource observations and creates the check-run

inputPolicy.unsupported: other artifact dialects are rejected before semantic projection
inputPolicy.regeneration: regenerate an artifact from its producer, then validate the regenerated native artifact
